name: billie-lace-gown-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: Create a sophisticated staircase mirror selfie centered on architectural lace tailoring and realistic phone photography.

prompt.project_info: 9:16 raw-phone fashion selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with natural porcelain-toned skin texture, long glossy brunette hair, refined makeup and a calm expression; wearing an off-white floral-lace architectural gown with long sleeves, square neckline and opaque lining.
prompt.composition_elements: Mirror-selfie composition with a pink smartphone partly obscuring the face, head slightly tilted downward and one hand resting naturally near the upper chest; beige brick masonry, dark wood banister and white balusters form the staircase background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft neutral indoor illumination, realistic ambient occlusion in lace, natural shadows on masonry and physically plausible mirror reflections.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16, raw iPhone-style photography, 35mm, f/5.6 total depth, sharp focus, authentic digital grain, detailed lace texture and realistic skin.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 9:16 raw-phone staircase mirror selfie of a clearly adult original woman with long glossy brunette hair wearing an off-white floral-lace gown with opaque lining, long sleeves and a square neckline, pink smartphone partly covering her face, beige brick wall, dark wood banister and white balusters, soft neutral light, realistic reflections and authentic digital grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, sheer exposure, exaggerated anatomy, logos, text, watermark, distorted hands, extra limbs, broken reflections
